card.name: Notes about archived or downloadable web pages
card.fires_on: Small words (be, not, and, may, a, to, an opening parenthesis) inside web-page notices about archived pages, old links or PDF downloads, just before the text moves to a new section.

modes.label: Archive notice
modes.description: Words inside the standard line saying an archived page will not be altered or updated.
modes.example: This page will not<< be>> altered or updated.

modes.label: PDF download notes
modes.description: Small words or a bracket near PDF download links and file-size remarks.

modes.label: Old-site link notes
modes.description: Words in a note that a link leads to a page on an old site.
modes.example: the link to the related Times article will take you<< to>> a page on the old site.
